title: Phase 1: Pare down br to simple agent-compatible team tracker
description:
Fork-based simplification of br into a clean team issue tracker. Target use: human-primary teams where each developer has a per-dev AI agent handling task updates and sync bookkeeping. CRDT peer-to-peer sync planned as future transport layer; br emits and reads issues.jsonl as its i/o surface.

Key design decisions from planning session:
- Sync model: flush (DB->JSONL) + dirty-preserving import (JSONL->DB). Conflict = hard stop.
- No 3-way merge: export_hashes table serves as per-issue base for conflict detection.
- Status set: Open, InProgress, Draft, Deferred, Closed, Tombstone
- Dep types: blocks, parent-child, related, duplicates
- Issue body: description only (cut design/AC/notes)
- IDs: keep hash-based (conflict-free for CRDT)
- Output: keep rich_rust + JSON, cut toon_rust
- MCP: keep as feature flag
- TUI: phase 2 (full editor, ratatui+crossterm); phase 1 must keep storage layer clean and separate from CLI formatting
close_reason: Duplicate of beads_rust-dgi — created by a failed first attempt

title: Rewrite sync engine: dirty-preserving import, cut 3-way merge and witness system
description:
Replace the 3-way merge sync engine with a simpler dirty-preserving import. The CRDT sync layer (external, future) owns conflict resolution between peers; br only needs to protect local unflushed work during import.

CUT ENTIRELY:
- src/sync/witness.rs (~1,894 lines) — Merkle JSONL witnesses, not wired to flush/import paths
- src/sync/history.rs (~1,375 lines) — local snapshot management; git history is the recovery path
- .beads/beads.base.jsonl — common ancestor for 3-way merge; no longer needed
- Three-way merge engine in sync/mod.rs: three_way_merge(), merge_issue(), MergeContext, MergeReport, ConflictType, ConflictResolution, MergeResult, load_base_snapshot(), save_base_snapshot*() (~400 lines)
- 4-phase collision detection in sync/mod.rs (lines ~3680-4424, ~1,900 lines) — replace with simple upsert
- Tombstone preservation helpers (only needed for --rebuild mode, which is cut)
- Staleness/witness tracking: compute_staleness(), auto_import_probe_refreshing_witnesses(), etc.
- sync/mod.rs: compute_staleness_refreshing_witnesses(), build_base_witness_artifacts()

CUT SYNC MODES from src/cli/commands/sync.rs:
- execute_merge() — three-way merge mode
- execute_status() — staleness/witness-based status (separate from basic import/export)
- execute_witness() + build_witness_for_path() — witness computation
- maybe_delegate_rebuild() — rebuild/reset mode

KEEP:
- --flush-only: DB -> JSONL export (unchanged from current)
- --import-only: JSONL -> DB (rewritten with new logic below)

NEW IMPORT LOGIC (replaces 4-phase collision detection):
Algorithm:
  1. Check for conflict markers in JSONL (keep existing ensure_no_conflict_markers())
  2. Parse all issues from JSONL (keep read_issues_from_jsonl())
  3. Get dirty issue IDs + marked_at from dirty_issues table (get_dirty_issue_metadata())
  4. For each issue in incoming JSONL:
     a. If issue_id is in dirty_issues AND incoming content_hash != export_hashes[issue_id].content_hash:
        -> CONFLICT: add to conflict_list with {id, local_version, remote_version}
     b. If issue_id is in dirty_issues AND hashes match (peer didn't change it):
        -> Skip (local DB wins)
     c. Otherwise: upsert from JSONL (remote wins)
     d. New issues (not in DB): insert directly
  5. If conflict_list is non-empty: rollback, return hard error with full conflict report
     Error format: {conflicts: [{id, title, local_updated_at, remote_updated_at}], message: 'Flush first to include your local changes, then re-import'}
  6. Otherwise: commit, update export_hashes for all imported issues, update metadata['last_import_time']

Key tables used (all already exist):
- dirty_issues: which issues have unflushed local changes
- export_hashes: content_hash at last flush (serves as per-issue 'base' without beads.base.jsonl)

title: Add minimal br check command (replaces doctor)
description:
New command src/cli/commands/check.rs (~200 lines) providing essential workspace health checks. Replaces the 19,000-line doctor command with three targeted checks.

THREE CHECKS:
1. Conflict marker detection
   - Reuse existing ensure_no_conflict_markers() from src/sync/mod.rs
   - Checks issues.jsonl for <<<<<<</=======/>>>>>>> git conflict markers
   - Error: 'Resolve git merge conflicts in issues.jsonl before syncing'

2. Schema version check
   - Query: SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE key = 'schema_version'
   - Compare against current expected schema version constant
   - Warn if mismatch: 'Schema version X found, expected Y. Run br sync --import-only to migrate.'

3. Lock file staleness check
   - stat .beads/.write.lock and .beads/.sync.lock
   - Warn if mtime > 1 hour: 'Stale lock file detected at PATH (age: Xm). May indicate a crashed process.'

OUTPUT FORMAT (--json):
{
  'status': 'ok' | 'warn' | 'error',
  'checks': [
    {'name': 'conflict_markers', 'status': 'ok'|'warn'|'error', 'message': '...'},
    {'name': 'schema_version', 'status': 'ok'|'warn'|'error', 'message': '...'},
    {'name': 'lock_files', 'status': 'ok'|'warn'|'error', 'message': '...'}
  ]
}

Exit codes: 0=all ok, 1=at least one warn, 2=at least one error

Plain text output: table with check name, status icon, message.
